mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a financial tool to transfer risks associated with farming to a third party via payment of a premium that reflects the true long term cost to the insurer assuming those risks."

Agricultural insurance is a financial tool to transfer risks associated with farming to a third party via payment of a premium that reflects the true long term cost to the insurer assuming those risks.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a means of assigning a value to a risky alternative."
Computing the expected value is a means of assigning a value to a risky alternative.

The coefficient of variation is a statistical measure of variability based on all of the values for yields or prices, not just the high, low, and average.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is referred to as Nigerian Incentive-Based Risk Sharing System for Agricultural Lending (NIRSAL)."
The initiative is referred to as Nigerian Incentive-Based Risk Sharing System for Agricultural Lending (NIRSAL).

Exposure is the first action in assessing risk.

Diversification of farm business income is one of the on-farm strategies of risk management.

Remember that exposure is the number of resources (personnel or equipment) affected by a given event or by repeated events over time.

employment are used to supplement farm incomes thereby reduce income variability.

Risk transfer refers to the transfer of the potential financial consequences of particular risks from one party to another.

Vertical integration is a type of management control.

Agriculture can be defined as the production of food, feed, fiber and other products by the systematic growing and harvesting of plants and rearing of animals to sustain life.

Price stabilisation policies are used by government to combat price risk vis-à-vis production risk.

Diversification is a frequently used extant risk management strategy that involves participating in more than one activity.
